verdict.why: `wrangler preview` deployments now automatically get an extra pull request title annotation without any config change.

draft.detail: wrangler preview now attaches the detected pull request title as the workers/pull_request_title annotation; best effort

test.error: FAIL: wrangler preview does not attach a workers/pull_request_title annotation from PULL_REQUEST_TITLE

source.quote: `wrangler preview` now also detects the title of the pull/merge request associated with the current CI run (GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, plus a generic `PULL_REQUEST_TITLE` fallback) and attaches it to the preview deployment as the `workers/pull_request_title` annotation
